title: 第19章 刺杀后遗症第20章 统领巡防营
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 听到暗卫禀报后，萧鼎锋那因为晚上出现的温馨场面而带来的笑容，瞬间变得狰狞扭曲起来，整个气势瞬间在御书房内散发出来，整个人如同被点燃的火药桶一般，当场暴走！
一旁的刘雨看到如此失态的萧鼎锋，连忙出声提醒，这才让萧鼎锋将气势收敛起来，但是刘雨也是很久没有见到萧鼎锋如此的失态了，要知道，因为修为的关系，平日里的萧鼎锋像向来是沉着冷静，像这般大发雷霆是极为罕见的。
刘雨细细的回想了一下，上次萧鼎锋如此动怒，还是因为与几大世家的家主产生激烈冲突之时。然而这次，几位皇子同时遭遇刺杀，尽管最终并未得逞，但是这种行径无疑是对皇家威严赤裸裸的挑衅，简直就是在当众扇皇室的耳光啊！想到此处，刘雨的心中同样燃起了熊熊怒火。
萧鼎锋面色阴沉地凝视着跪在下方的暗卫，那凌厉的目光仿佛能穿透对方的灵魂。他缓缓开口道：“立刻通知所有暗卫，给我彻查此事！将幕后黑手给我找出来！还有，增派人手加强对几位皇子的护卫工作。”
话音刚落，跪在地上的暗卫不禁浑身一颤，连忙应声道：“遵命，陛下！属下这就去办！”说完，他不敢有丝毫耽搁，直接转身出了大殿。
就在刚才，萧鼎锋瞬间释放出强大的气势，如同排山倒海一般汹涌而至。尽管那股骇人的气势仅仅只持续了短短的一瞬，但是他却清晰无比地感受到了其中蕴含的无尽威压。他深知若不能尽快查出背后之人，平息萧鼎锋的怒火，那么不仅自己难逃一死，就连整个暗卫组织或许都会面临一场大清洗。想到此处，他脚下步伐更快，向其他的暗卫传达命令并开始调查。
与此同时，在燕京城内各个皇子的府邸，还有其背后的世家以及支持者，都收到了有皇子被刺杀的消息，他们也是纷纷赶到各自支持的皇子府邸，确认消息，就连丞相府都派出人到萧风那里打探情况了，再加上暗卫对刺杀之人的搜查，整个燕京城都处在了一股莫名的氛围中。
而在二皇子府邸中，一众门客和大臣都聚集在书房中，萧鸿坐在主位上看着眼前一群人乱哄哄的在谈论今晚发生的事情，虽然他自己清楚是怎么回事，但是还是不能告诉这些人，只能是挥手示意让众人安静下来，开口道：“今晚的刺杀，父皇会去查，大家就不要再讨论了，记住，最近不要太招摇，暗卫已经开始调查了。”随后便遣散了众人。
当众人散去，二皇子招来了自己的心腹问道：“你在血月楼发单的时候，确定是只发了老七的单吗？怎么其他的皇子也受到了遇袭？”
“殿下，奴才确定啊，我现在也不敢去联系血月楼，明天早上，我再去看看，殿下，今晚的情况您能打听到吗？”心腹也是想根据现场来判断一下，是不是都是血月楼的杀手。
“不行，我不能去联系暗卫中的人，现在暗卫全员出动，现在只能等明天早朝之后了，你明天溜出去，联系一下血月楼，弄清楚情况再说吧。”
“是的殿下，奴才下去了，还有给您弄了一个鲜货，在您房间，您慢慢享用。”心腹随后猥琐的笑了笑，便转身离去。
二皇子萧鸿看着离去的心腹，也是对他的行为很满意，虽然修为不高，但是却非常了解他的需求，所以才一直留在身边。
萧鸿转身就向房中走去，毕竟他没有什么爱好，就是喜欢女人罢了。
其他几个皇子的府邸，特别是遇袭的几位皇子，背后的人又是招名医，又是增加护卫，生怕再次遇袭。
大皇子萧凯却是觉得这次的刺杀很古怪，只是击碎了马车，和几名普通侍卫，暗卫出手的瞬间就选择了撤退，这不符合杀手的逻辑，既然要来刺杀他，就知道他身边是有暗卫保护的，为何暗卫一出手，他们那些人便直接退走了？太不正常了。但是想来想去又想不到什么，只能是放弃了，明日的早朝应该就有结果了吧。
六皇子萧云府邸中，萧云在书房见了一位黑衣人，那人浑身只露出了眼睛，“为何我也会受到刺杀？”
“这样你的那位陛下才不会注意你，而且我发的只是袭击单，还是个新的杀手组织，不会查到了”黑衣人不紧不慢的说着。
“最好是，你出事了，不要拖累我。老七那边也是你发的？”
“不是，萧风那边是血月楼的杀手，不知道是谁，而且去刺杀的全部被杀了，一个活口都没有，而且萧风亲自出手了，修为应该在黄阶，但是具体的不清楚，应该不会太高，因为最后他身边的太监还补了一下。”
“老七能修行是很正常的，毕竟哪个皇子不能修行？但是他这么快就到了黄阶，就有点说不过去了，估计父皇一直在培养老七，只是我们都没有发觉。”萧云沉声道。
“不排除这种可能，汉王殿下的府邸现在可不是那么好探的，我派了很多人，都杳无音信了，说明他府中是有高手的，而且还不少。”黑衣人也是想起自己损失的人手，愤愤不平的说道。
“好了先不说这些了，最近安分点，暗卫会一直调查此事，而且现在的暗卫是全员出动，你就待在府邸，那也不要走动了，等风头过了，再说吧。”萧云说完，便转身离开了。
御书房内，萧鼎锋看着暗卫递上来的奏折，一直没有开口，不知道在想什么，随后将奏折递给了站在一旁的刘雨，刘雨看着上面的内容，也是一个头两大，看了萧鼎锋一眼，便让暗卫下去了，当暗卫走后，刘雨又让其他在殿内伺候的人出去，才开口道：“陛下，这结果......”
萧鼎锋没有开口，只是向黑暗中招了招手，黑暗中走出一人影，开口道：“奏折上的内容是真的，我已经安排人盯住去血月楼发单的人了，至于其他皇子的刺杀是由一个新的杀手组织“莫问”接单的，但是因为这个组织是最近才冒头的，我们还没有注意到，也没有办法查到发单人，但是他们却很奇怪，这次之后宣布不接朝堂的单子了，而且还送来了些赔偿，给其他的几位皇子。”

content_en:
After hearing the secret guard's report, Xiao Dingfeng's smile caused by the warm scene that happened at night became ferocious and twisted in an instant. The entire aura instantly spread out in the imperial study room. The whole person was like a ignited gunpowder keg, and he ran away on the spot!
Liu Yu on the side saw Xiao Dingfeng losing his composure and quickly reminded him, which made Xiao Dingfeng calm down. However, Liu Yu had not seen Xiao Dingfeng lose his composure like this for a long time. You know, because of his cultivation, Xiao Dingfeng usually seemed calm and collected, and it was extremely rare for him to get angry like this.
Liu Yu thought about it carefully. The last time Xiao Dingfeng was so angry was because of fierce conflicts with the heads of several major families. However, this time, several princes were assassinated at the same time. Although they did not succeed in the end, this behavior was undoubtedly a naked provocation to the majesty of the royal family. It was simply a slap in the face of the royal family in public! Thinking of this, Liu Yu's heart also ignited with raging anger.
Xiao Dingfeng stared at the secret guard kneeling below with a gloomy expression, his sharp eyes seeming to penetrate the other person's soul. He slowly said: "Notify all the secret guards immediately and investigate this matter thoroughly for me! Find the mastermind behind this! Also, send more manpower to strengthen the protection of several princes."
As soon as he finished speaking, the secret guard who was kneeling on the ground couldn't help but trembled, and quickly responded: "Yes, Your Majesty! I will do it now!" After saying that, he did not dare to delay at all, and turned around and left the hall.
Just now, Xiao Dingfeng released a powerful momentum in an instant, surging like an overwhelming force. Although the terrifying momentum only lasted for a short moment, he could clearly feel the endless pressure contained in it. He knew that if he could not find out the person behind it as soon as possible and calm down Xiao Dingfeng's anger, not only would he die, but the entire secret guard organization might also face a major purge. Thinking of this, he walked faster, conveyed the order to the other secret guards and began to investigate.
At the same time, the princes' mansions in Yanjing City, as well as the aristocratic families and supporters behind them, all received news that the prince had been assassinated. They rushed to the princes' mansions they supported to confirm the news. Even the Prime Minister's Mansion sent people to Xiao Feng to inquire about the situation. Coupled with the secret guards' search for the assassin, the entire Yanjing City was in an inexplicable atmosphere.
In the second prince's residence, all the guests and ministers gathered in the study. Xiao Hong sat in the main seat and watched a group of people in front of him chatting noisily about what happened tonight. Although he knew what was going on, he still couldn't tell these people. He could only wave his hands to quiet everyone down and said: "My father will investigate tonight's assassination, so please stop discussing it. Remember, don't be too showy recently. The secret guards have begun investigating." Then he dismissed everyone.
When everyone dispersed, the second prince summoned his confidants and asked, "When you issued orders at the Blood Moon Tower, were you sure you only issued orders to the seventh child? Why were the other princes also attacked?"
"Your Highness, I am sure, I don't dare to contact Xueyue Tower now. I will go and have a look tomorrow morning. Your Highness, can you find out what happened tonight?" The confidants also wanted to judge based on the scene whether they were all killers from Xueyue Tower.
"No, I can't contact the people in the secret guard. Now that all the secret guards are dispatched, we can only wait until after tomorrow morning. You can sneak out tomorrow, contact the Blood Moon Tower, and find out the situation."
"Yes, Your Highness, I have gone down and I have prepared something fresh for you. It will be in your room for you to enjoy slowly." The confidant then smiled obscenely, then turned and left.
The second prince Xiao Hong looked at his departing confidant and was very satisfied with his behavior. Although his cultivation was not high, he understood his needs very well, so he stayed by his side.
Xiao Hong turned around and walked towards the room. After all, he didn't have any hobbies, he just liked women.
The people behind the residences of several other princes, especially the princes who were attacked, were recruiting famous doctors and adding more guards for fear of being attacked again.
The eldest prince, Xiao Kai, felt that this assassination was very strange. He only smashed the carriage and a few ordinary guards. The secret guards chose to retreat the moment they took action. This did not conform to the logic of the assassin. Since he was going to assassinate him, he knew that he was protected by secret guards. Why did they retreat as soon as the secret guards took action? It's so abnormal. But after much deliberation, I couldn't think of anything, so I had to give up. There should be results tomorrow morning.
In the residence of the sixth prince Xiao Yun, Xiao Yun met a man in black in the study. Only his eyes were exposed. "Why am I also being assassinated?"
"This way your Majesty won't pay attention to you, and what I sent out was just a raid order. It's a new killer organization, so it won't be discovered," the man in black said unhurriedly.
"It's best if something happens to you, don't drag me down. Was it you who sent it to Lao Qi?"
"No, Xiao Feng is the assassin from the Blood Moon Tower. I don't know who it is. Moreover, all those who went to assassinate him were killed, and there was no one left alive. Moreover, Xiao Feng took the action himself. His cultivation level should be at the Huang level, but the details are not clear. It should not be too high, because the eunuch next to him made up for it in the end."
"It's normal for Lao Qi to be able to practice. After all, which prince can't practice? But it's a bit unreasonable for him to reach the Huang rank so quickly. I guess my father has been training Lao Qi, but we didn't realize it." Xiao Yun said in a deep voice.
"We don't rule out this possibility. His Royal Highness's mansion is not so easy to explore now. I sent many people, but there is no news. It means that there are experts in his mansion, and there are quite a few." The man in black also thought of the manpower he had lost, and said angrily.
"Okay, let's not talk about this for now. Please stay calm recently. The secret guards will continue to investigate this matter, and all the secret guards are currently deployed. You just stay in the mansion, so don't move around. Let's wait until the limelight passes." After Xiao Yun finished speaking, he turned and left.
In the royal study, Xiao Dingfeng looked at the memorial handed over by the secret guard, but remained silent. He didn't know what he was thinking. Then he handed the memorial to Liu Yu who was standing aside. Liu Yu looked at the content and was also impressed. He glanced at Xiao Dingfeng and asked the secret guard to go down. When the secret guard left, Liu Yu asked other people serving in the palace to go out, and then said: "Your Majesty, the result..."
Xiao Dingfeng did not speak, but just waved to the darkness, and a figure walked out of the darkness and said: "The content in the memorial is true. I have arranged for people to keep an eye on the people who went to Xueyue Tower to issue orders. As for the assassinations of other princes, they were carried out by a new killer organization "Mo Wen" But because this organization only appeared recently, we haven't noticed it yet, and there is no way to find the person who issued the order, but they are very strange. After this time, they announced that they would not accept orders from the court, and they also sent some compensation to several other princes. "
